locations.Ice Cavern Frozen Blue Rupee:
can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_FREESTANDING_COLLECTIBLE_BOULDER') or
                (boulder_type('ICE_CAVERN_FREESTANDING_COLLECTIBLE_BOULDER') == BOULDER_TYPE_RED_ICE and (Blue_Fire or logic_ice_frozen_rupee)) or
                (logic_boomerang_boulders and can_use(Boomerang))

exits.Ice Cavern Spinning Scythe Room:
has_soul(Freezard) and here(is_adult or has_explosives or can_use(Dins_Fire)
                    or can_use(Megaton_Hammer))

exits.Ice Cavern Map Room:
((is_adult or (glitch_ice_map_child and can_groundjump)) and (Silver_Rupee_Ice_Cavern_Spinning_Scythe, 5))
                or (is_adult and can_lunge_storage)
exits.Ice Cavern Compass Room:
can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_TOWARDS_COMPASS_BOULDER') or 
                (is_adult and glitch_ledge_clip) or 
                (boulder_type('ICE_CAVERN_TOWARDS_COMPASS_BOULDER') == BOULDER_TYPE_RED_ICE and can_lunge_storage) or
                (can_use(Hover_Boots) and is_glitched and logic_hovers_recoil)
exits.Ice Cavern Push Block Room:
can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_TOWARDS_BLOCK_PUSH_BOULDER') or 
                (boulder_type('ICE_CAVERN_TOWARDS_BLOCK_PUSH_BOULDER') == BOULDER_TYPE_RED_ICE and can_lunge_storage) or
                (can_use(Hover_Boots) and is_glitched and logic_hovers_recoil)

locations.Ice Cavern Map Chest:
can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_MAP_BOULDER') or 
                (is_glitched and boulder_type('ICE_CAVERN_MAP_BOULDER') == BOULDER_TYPE_RED_ICE and
                    has_explosives and damage_multiplier != 'ohko')

locations.Ice Cavern Compass Chest:
can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_COMPASS_CHEST_BOULDER') or 
                (is_glitched and boulder_type('ICE_CAVERN_COMPASS_CHEST_BOULDER') == BOULDER_TYPE_RED_ICE and
                    has_explosives and damage_multiplier != 'ohko')
locations.Ice Cavern Freestanding PoH:
can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_FREESTANDING_POH_BOULDER') or (logic_ice_HP_no_bottle and
            boulder_type('ICE_CAVERN_FREESTANDING_POH_BOULDER') == BOULDER_TYPE_RED_ICE and
                    Bombs and can_shield and can_jumpslash and damage_multiplier != 'ohko')

locations.Ice Cavern Push Block Silver Rupee Red I:
can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_BLOCK_PUSH_SILVER_RUPEE_BOULDER') or 
                (boulder_type('ICE_CAVERN_BLOCK_PUSH_SILVER_RUPEE_BOULDER') == BOULDER_TYPE_RED_ICE and can_jumpslash and logic_ice_push_block_silver)
locations.Ice Cavern GS Push Block Room:
can_use(Hookshot) or can_use(Boomerang) or
                (logic_ice_block_gs and can_use(Hover_Boots)) or can_hover

exits.Ice Cavern Spinning Scythe Room:
can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_TOWARDS_BLOCK_PUSH_BOULDER') or 
                boulder_type('ICE_CAVERN_TOWARDS_BLOCK_PUSH_BOULDER') == BOULDER_TYPE_RED_ICE or
                (can_use(Hover_Boots) and is_glitched and logic_hovers_recoil)

exits.Ice Cavern End Room:
can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_NEAR_END_BOULDER_1') or 
                    can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_NEAR_END_BOULDER_2') or 
                    can_pass_boulder('ICE_CAVERN_NEAR_END_BOULDER_3') or
                    (logic_hovers_recoil and can_use(Hover_Boots)) or 
                    can_mega or can_hess

exits.Ice Cavern End Hallway:
can_kill_wolfos and (
                can_mega or can_hess or (logic_hovers_recoil and can_use(Hover_Boots)))
